errors.detail: Model has 6 compartments but no externalSinks (death flows). Endemic disease models typically require death sinks.
Compartment 'Infectious 2' has no outgoing flow or sink. This breaks the flow chain.
Parameter 'μ_ICU|E' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'σ^2_ICU|E' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
